description: Summary provenance figure: locus architecture, splice-grammar conservation, and mouse vs human in-silico chimeric protein
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os
# Values all recomputed above from Ensembl REST (GRCh38 / GRCm39) and verified against PMID 42686912 source data.
mouse_pep="MPSAFEKVVKNVIKEVSGSRGDLIPVDSLRNSTSFRPYCLLNRKFSSSRFWKPRYSCVNLSIKDILEPSAPEPECPEHLQQQLLSHHSDTADGRGAPPGLCGRPGHQQPPPAHRPIGQ"
human_pep="MGSAFERVVRRVVQELDHGGEFIPVTSLQSSTGFQPYCLVVRKPSSSWFWKPRYKCVNLSIKDILEPDAAEPEYLKHLQWQLLPHYGDTADPRGSAPVPRGGAGFQQPSPTHWPFGQ"
mj,hj=73,72   # last GSDMD-derived residue

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13,8.2))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,1,height_ratios=[1.05,0.95,1.25],hspace=0.55)

# -- panel A: loci
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0]); ax.axis("off")
rows=[("mouse",  "Gsdmd  chr15:75,733,974-75,739,257 (+)", "Tmem106a  chr11:101,473,064-101,482,633 (+)"),
      ("human",  "GSDMD  chr8:143,553,207-143,563,062 (+)","TMEM106A  chr17:43,211,835-43,220,041 (+)")]
for i,(sp,a,b) in enumerate(rows):
    y=0.72-i*0.45
    ax.text(0.0,y+0.13,sp,fontsize=11,weight="bold")
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.10,y),0.33,0.14,color="#4c72b0"))
    ax.text(0.265,y+0.07,a,ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=8.3)
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.56,y),0.37,0.14,color="#c2403d"))
    ax.text(0.745,y+0.07,b,ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=8.3)
    ax.annotate("",xy=(0.56,y+0.07),xytext=(0.43,y+0.07),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->",ls="--",color="#555"))
    ax.text(0.495,y+0.15,"different\nchromosomes",ha="center",fontsize=7.5,color="#555")
ax.set_xlim(0,1); ax.set_ylim(0,1)
ax.set_title("A  Parent loci are on different chromosomes in BOTH species: no intergenic distance, no read-through route",
             fontsize=10.5,loc="left")

# -- panel B: exon phase architecture
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1]); ax.axis("off")
tbl=pd.DataFrame({
 "feature":["GSDMD exon 2 CDS (nt)","CDS phase left by GSDMD exon-2 donor","GSDMD intron-2 donor dinucleotide",
            "TMEM106A exon 6 length (nt)","TMEM106A exon 6 native 5' phase","TMEM106A intron-5 acceptor dinucleotide",
            "frame shift of TMEM106A in chimera","out-of-frame ORF length (aa)","stop codon located in"],
 "mouse":["220","1","GT","141","0","AG","+2 (out of frame)","44","TMEM106A exon 6"],
 "human":["217","1","GT","141","0","AG","+2 (out of frame)","44","TMEM106A exon 6"]})
t=ax.table(cellText=tbl.values,colLabels=["splice-grammar feature","mouse","human"],
           cellLoc="center",loc="center",colWidths=[0.48,0.22,0.22])
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(8.2); t.scale(1,1.22)
for (r,c),cell in t.get_celld().items():
    cell.set_edgecolor("#dddddd")
    if r==0: cell.set_facecolor("#eef1f5"); cell.set_text_props(weight="bold")
    elif c>0: cell.set_facecolor("#eaf3ea")
ax.set_title("B  Every splice feature required for the mouse chimera is identical in human",fontsize=10.5,loc="left")

# -- panel C: protein alignment
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2]); ax.axis("off")
n=max(len(mouse_pep),len(human_pep)); W=1.0/ (n+2)
for k,(pep,j,lab) in enumerate([(mouse_pep,mj,"mouse G-T (118 aa)"),(human_pep,hj,"human in-silico (117 aa)")]):
    y=0.56-k*0.20
    ax.text(-0.005,y+0.035,lab,ha="right",fontsize=8.5,weight="bold")
    for i,a in enumerate(pep):
        same = i<min(len(mouse_pep),len(human_pep)) and mouse_pep[i]==human_pep[i]
        col = "#4c72b0" if i<j else "#c2403d"
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((i*W,y),W*0.92,0.075,color=col,alpha=1.0 if same else 0.33))
        ax.text(i*W+W*0.46,y+0.037,a,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=4.6,color="white")
ax.text(-0.005,0.80,"",ha="right")
ax.annotate("",xy=(mj*W,0.70),xytext=(mj*W,0.64),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="black"))
ax.text(mj*W,0.72,"trans-splice junction\n(GSDMD ex2 | TMEM106A ex6)",ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
for pos,lab in [(49,"F50/W51\nmembrane anchor"),(71,"E72/E74"),(88,"D89/D92\nacidic patch")]:
    ax.annotate("",xy=(pos*W,0.33),xytext=(pos*W,0.26),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#444"))
    ax.text(pos*W,0.10,lab,ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#444")
ax.text(0.0,-0.07,"solid = identical mouse/human; blue = GSDMD-encoded, red = TMEM106A-encoded out of frame. "
        "Overall 55% identity in the out-of-frame tail; all functional residues mapped by PMID 42686912 are conserved.",
        fontsize=7.6,color="#444")
ax.set_xlim(-0.14,1.02); ax.set_ylim(-0.12,0.88)
ax.set_title("C  The human locus encodes the same 117-aa chimeric protein in silico, with all tested residues conserved",
             fontsize=10.5,loc="left")
plt.show()

print("Identity in out-of-frame tail:",
      sum(a==b for a,b in zip(mouse_pep[mj:],human_pep[hj:]))/min(len(mouse_pep)-mj,len(human_pep)-hj))
print("human residues 49,50 / 71,73 / 88,91 =",human_pep[48],human_pep[49],"/",human_pep[70],human_pep[72],"/",human_pep[87],human_pep[90])
print("mouse  residues 50,51 / 72,74 / 89,92 =",mouse_pep[49],mouse_pep[50],"/",mouse_pep[71],mouse_pep[73],"/",mouse_pep[88],mouse_pep[91])
